title: Basic English — Course 1, Semester 1 — Pilot Variant 08

tasks.prompt: Listening 1. Listen to the library announcement. Why will the library close early on Thursday?
tasks.audioText: Good morning, everyone. The college library will close early this Thursday because staff are checking the computer system. It will close at two o'clock instead of six. Students can return books using the box beside the main entrance. If you need to use a computer, please visit the study room in Building B. The library will open at its usual time on Friday.
options: The computer system is being checked
A new book exhibition is opening

tasks.prompt: Listening 2. Where can students return books after the library closes?
tasks.audioText: Good morning, everyone. The college library will close early this Thursday because staff are checking the computer system. It will close at two o'clock instead of six. Students can return books using the box beside the main entrance. If you need to use a computer, please visit the study room in Building B. The library will open at its usual time on Friday.
options: In the box beside the main entrance

tasks.prompt: Reading 1. Read the text. Dmitri is doing a short work-placement programme at a local engineering company. On his first day, his supervisor showed him the workshop and explained the safety rules. Dmitri must wear safety glasses and protective shoes in the production area. He keeps a small notebook to record new technical words and instructions. At the end of each week, he discusses his progress with the supervisor. What does Dmitri use to record new words and instructions?
Reading 2. When does Dmitri discuss his progress with the supervisor?
options: At the end of each week
Only when there is a problem

tasks.prompt: Choose the correct modal verb: 'You ___ wear safety glasses in the production area.'
Choose TWO instructions that are grammatically correct.
options: You must to wear protective shoes.

tasks.prompt: Complete the sentence with one word: 'A person who manages and guides a trainee at work is a ___.'
You do not understand a safety instruction. What is the best response?
options: Could you explain that instruction again, please?

tasks.prompt: Put these actions for starting a safe workshop task in a sensible order.
options: Put on the required protective equipment
Check that the work area is safe
correctOrder: Put on the required protective equipment
Check that the work area is safe

tasks.prompt: Write 60–80 words about safety rules at a workshop, laboratory or other place of study. Describe two important rules, explain why they matter and say what protective equipment may be needed.
tasks.rubric: 8 points total: two relevant rules and explanations (0–2); understandable sentence structure and grammar (0–2); suitable safety vocabulary (0–2); spelling, punctuation and organisation (0–2). Minor errors are acceptable if meaning remains clear.
